title: Rework the book cache material into the guarantee-first decision map
acceptance_criteria: The cache material follows the guarantee-first flow: name the contract, establish writer-observation completeness, identify source capabilities, choose topology and publication protocol, then performance controls separately
A protocol table carries an evidence-status column separating active registered claim, newer signed but unregistered evidence, mechanism demonstrated, and proposed/unmeasured
Every lock-avoidance sentence names the specific race it addresses: database mutation lock, fill lease, publication fence/CAS, source version token, or outbox
The private-memory three-instance result is stated so its zero wrong reads are not read as safety: the arm had zero cache hits and 15k-21k bypass reads
Relaxed staleness is defined against the strict comparator and never presented as a dirty or impossible value
Every number resolves to a registered claim of the active evidence version; the book rebuilds and the manifest records the evidence digest
expected_artifacts: reworked book concept and chapter sources
validation: HIGH review maps every numeric sentence to a registered claim
Book build passes with the evidence digest present
